title: Tranched (staggered) rebalancing of the carry sleeves: 7 tranches with day offsets 0..6, averaged (removes rebalance timing luck; 2 trials)
model: for every premium-carry sleeve of the book, the 7-day-hold weights are computed for each start offset 0..6 and averaged (each tranche rebalances once a week on its own day); signal, universe, leg weights and costs unchanged. v8.5: 'premium carry' (20 coins, invvol) and 'premium carry 60'; bf2.4: 'premium carry' (11 CFD coins, equal legs as in bf2.4) and 'premium carry BF'
why: a fixed weekly rebalance day is arbitrary; its luck (Hoffstein, 'rebalance timing luck') adds noise that tranching removes at no extra turnover in expectation
